CRM: people, companies, deals, lists, notes and tasks in one Attio workspace.

## API key

1. Open [attio.com](https://attio.com/help/reference/apps/generating-an-api-key) and create an API key with only the access your apps need.
2. Copy it. It may be shown only once.

**What to create:** An access token a workspace admin makes under Workspace settings > Developers, scoped to what the app needs.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add attio
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  attio: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls Attio's [API](https://docs.attio.com/rest-api/overview) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. Use `"write"` if the app changes things. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show attio` shows the key as set.

**Rate limits:** 100 calls a second. 100 reads and 25 writes per second; listing records and entries also has score-based limits.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Attio).
